raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The D576 extension in #1902 left three host-only assertions describing the previous source layout, causing the routine SM80/SM100/SM103 lanes to fail. Update the two append-only `Capabilities` field lists to include `thd_excluded_d_shapes`, and count the two mutually exclusive BMM1 completion sites for the two-/three-chunk QK branches. Each runtime branch still commits once after its final chunk.

This changes three tests only; runtime code, barrier counts, numerical tolerances and public APIs are unchanged.

Validation: all three original test functions reproduce the CI failures on the parent and pass after the patch, using imports from this worktree. Scoped `pre-commit run --files` passes. The reported lane failures are these same three assertions; their summaries report no numerical failure and 11,233 / 18,108 / 17,832 passing tests respectively.

- [x] Scoped pre-commit checks passed and formatting changes are committed.
- [x] Reviewed the applicable root and test AGENTS.md rules.
- [x] Required change-type, area and originator labels are applied.

files.patch:
@@ -456,14 +456,15 @@ def test_template_params_and_capabilities_are_appended():
         1,
     ), "a record without the fields renders the legacy tail, the full body, the two-group body and one S slot"
     # ... followed by the per-shape TILE_N domain (the TILE_N 64 cells of the small tiles), appended after them, then the
-    # PackGQA divisibility rule.
-    assert [f.name for f in dataclasses.fields(Capabilities)][-6:] == [
+    # PackGQA divisibility rule and per-shape THD exclusions.
+    assert [f.name for f in dataclasses.fields(Capabilities)][-7:] == [
         "bias_d_shapes",
         "bias_io_dtype_only",
         "kv_mask",
         "kv_mask_dtypes",
         "tile_ns_by_d_shape",
         "pack_gqa_requires_divisible",
+        "thd_excluded_d_shapes",
     ]

@@ -157,7 +157,7 @@ def test_config_2x2_rejects_off_contract_records():
     "mb_tmem_dealloc.arrive": 1,  # local ...
     "mb_tmem_dealloc.arrive_on_peer": 1,  # ... + on-peer = PAIR_LANES per CTA
     "mb_q_empty.arrive": 1,  # MMA commit after the tile's last BMM1
-    "mb_bmm1_done[": 1,
+    "mb_bmm1_done[": 2,  # mutually exclusive two-/three-chunk arms, one commit after the final QK chunk
     "mb_bmm2_done[": 2,  # per-iteration (last N-block) + empty-tile commit
 }

@@ -147,8 +147,8 @@ def test_capabilities_field_is_appended():
 
     names = [f.name for f in fields(Capabilities)]
     # ... the zero-scale and pre-folded-scale fields after it, then the resident-bias / kv_mask fields of the Rubin small tiles
-    # and their per-shape TILE_N domain after THOSE, then the PackGQA divisibility rule.
-    assert names[-11:] == [
+    # and their per-shape TILE_N domain after THOSE, then the PackGQA divisibility rule and per-shape THD exclusions.
+    assert names[-12:] == [
         "thd_pack_gqa_d_shapes",
         "zero_scale",
         "attn_scale_prefolded_d_shapes",
@@ -160,6 +160,7 @@ def test_capabilities_field_is_appended():
         "kv_mask_dtypes",
         "tile_ns_by_d_shape",
         "pack_gqa_requires_divisible",
+        "thd_excluded_d_shapes",
     ], names[-12:]
     assert Capabilities.__dataclass_fields__["score_stats_d_shapes"].default is None
     assert Capabilities.__dataclass_fields__["dense_only_d_shapes"].default == frozenset()
